name: Sun Descendant
_notes: Transcribed from sheet CU1792 + VP card (Feathery Ascent), AI CR1734-CR1754, BP CS1755-CS1772.
Mnestis: win by killing (Wound Stack full); the Endure-the-Sun round track is ignored.
Positions (Storybook p.132): A = cols 1-3 rows G-I (faces E), B = cols 10-12 rows L-N (faces S), C = cols 18-20 rows F-H (faces W), D = cols 9-11 rows A-C (faces N).
VP effect icon read as Power. ▽5+ icon on Fated Flash / Supernova read as PARADOX 5+.
Floating Rocks (CI1315): Obstacle, Obscuring, Indestructible, Elevated; climb Fury 4+; from it, free move to VP I of an adjacent Primordial; +3 to Climb tests.

traits.Sun Move: When the Sun Descendant performs a Sun Move, move it clockwise directly to the next position on the Battle Board (A, B, C or D), then turn to face the middle of the Board. This move does not trigger Crash.
traits.Merciless Sun: Start of Primordial Round: perform Merciless Sun. Unshaded Board: The Sun shines from the direction of the Board Edge directly behind the Sun Descendant after its Sun Move. Every space on the Board, excluding spaces adjacent to Obstacle and Obscuring Terrain on the side directly opposite that Board Edge, are considered Unshaded.
traits.Death by Fate: When a Primordial Attack deals FATE, it triggers a Trauma Draw (like DANGER). If an Attack deals both, resolve only one Trauma Draw. Being dealt FATE over 9 causes an Obol Draw instead of a Moiros Draw. Trauma severity uses the higher of DANGER or FATE.
traits.Extinguish Possibilities: Start of Primordial Round: Look at the top Trauma card from each deck. If it's positive, remove it from the Battle. If it's negative, leave it on top.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Magnifying Glass: All VPs become unshaded. After a Titan fails a Hold on test, perform Signature against that Titan.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Trigger Happy: The Signature becomes Trigger Finger (Secret card 118): LASER JUDGEMENT 2/11+, Target: Closest Titan in sight. ⚡ MOVE LATERAL & JUDGE — Chosen Skill. If you are hit, you are incinerated. After Attack: Burn.
traits.Ice Age: Treat every Battle Board space as if it had the Slippery keyword.
traits.Black Sun: If you are hit by Merciless Sun, you are incinerated (you die).
traits.Bow or Die: If you don't start the Primordial Round knocked down, you are incinerated (you die).
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Total Eclipse: Treat every Battle Board space as if it had the Chasm keyword.

vp.name: Feathery Ascent
vp.text: Starts with VP I unlocked. VP I and VP II are shaded, VP III is unshaded. All VPs are Elevated. You can move from one VP to another with a Move action. Climb (VP I): Fury 6+, (VP II): Fury 8+, (VP III): Fury 9+. Hold on — End of Primordial Round: If on a VP, test Endurance (7+). Fail: Knockdown, gain DANGER equal to VP level, Displace to any adjacent space. VP effects: VP I and II +1 Power, VP III +2 Power.
